question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a grey present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a silver present, Dave has a gold present, Eve has a pink present, Fred has a green present, and Gertrude has a brown present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Fred swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) grey present
(B) teal present
(C) silver present
(D) gold present
(E) pink present
(F) green present
(G) brown present
solution:
Present colors in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (grey, teal, silver, gold, pink, green, brown).
1. Claire and Eve swap: (grey, teal, pink, gold, silver, green, brown).
2. Bob and Eve swap: (grey, silver, pink, gold, teal, green, brown).
3. Alice and Bob swap: (silver, grey, pink, gold, teal, green, brown).
4. Bob and Fred swap: (silver, green, pink, gold, teal, grey, brown).
5. Claire and Dave swap: (silver, green, gold, pink, teal, grey, brown).
6. Claire and Dave swap: (silver, green, pink, gold, teal, grey, brown).
7. Claire and Fred swap: (silver, green, grey, gold, teal, pink, brown).
Gertrude has the brown present, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
